products.name: Stunner
products.desc: Concentration and size of biologics in one plate-based run.
products.lead: Plate-based dynamic light scattering and UV/Vis, built for biologics — concentration and size in a single run.
points: Measures protein concentration (UV/Vis) and hydrodynamic size (DLS) together
Plate-based format for screening many samples or formulations
products.why: Biologics teams usually measure concentration and size on separate instruments, using more sample and more time. Stunner combines both measurements in a plate, so you can screen candidates and formulations early and spot aggregation before it becomes a problem.
tiles: Many samples per run for screening.
